stories.title: Cosmoserve raises $6 million for space debris removal
stories.summary: Hyderabad-based Cosmoserve Space has raised $6 million in seed funding led by Rebright Partners. The company plans to use the capital for technology demonstrations and two upcoming missions. It aims to begin commercial operations by 2028. The startup has now raised over $9 million since its inception.

stories.summary: Spacetech startup Cosmoserve raises $6M in seed round Cosmoserve also opened a facility in Hyderabad which will be utilised for satellite servicing and space debris recovery. Cosmoserve Space, a Hyderabad-based spacetech startup, has raised $6 million in a seed round of funding from Rebright Partners

The opening follows a $6 million seed funding round, in which Japan’s Rebright Partners joined Aranya Holdings, Naandi Ventures, AUM Ventures

stories.title: Capgrid raises Rs 50 crore in pre-Series B round
stories.summary: Manufacturing technology platform Capgrid has raised Rs 50 crore in a pre-Series B round led by Hero Enterprise. The company operates a cloud-based platform that coordinates production and supply chain operations for original equipment manufacturers. It maintains an asset-light model by using a network of partner factories.

stories.title: altM raises $10.3 million for specialty chemicals
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM has raised $10.3 million in a Series A round led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The company plans to use the funds to scale manufacturing and commercialize bio-based chemicals derived from agricultural waste. It aims to build a commercial facility by 2028.

stories.title: Specialty chemicals startup altM raises $10.3 Mn led by Rainmatter, Mela Ventures
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based specialty chemicals startup altM has raised $10.3 million in a Series A funding round led by new investors Rainmatter by Zerodha and Mela Ventures. The round also saw participation from existing investors Omnivore, Theia Ventures, Aureolis Ventures and Spectrum Impact, along with VC Grid

stories.title: Cleantech Startup altM Raises $10.3 Mn To Scale Manufacturing
stories.summary: Cleantech startup altM has raised $10.3 Mn (₹97.5 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by new investors Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. Existing investors Omnivore, Theia Ventures, Aureolis Ventures and Spectrum Impact also participated. The Bengaluru-based startup plans to use the fresh capital to

stories.summary: Bengaluru-based deeptech startup altM has raised $10.3 million (about Rs 100 crore) in a round led by Rainmatter by Zerodha and Mela Ventures, as it looks to scale the production of specialty chemicals made from agricultural waste and reduce India's dependence on imported petrochemical-based materials.Existing

stories.title: Peppermint Robotics raises Rs 100 crore
stories.summary: Pune-based Peppermint Robotics has secured Rs 100 crore in a pre-Series B round led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners. The company plans to expand its manufacturing and develop new industrial robots. It expects to fall short of its Rs 100 crore revenue target for FY27.

stories.title: Nature Select raises over $100 million
stories.summary: Shenzhen-based AI social startup Nature Select has completed a Series A+ funding round, bringing its total fundraising to over $100 million. The company, founded in early 2024, develops AI companion products designed to build long-term relationships between people and AI. Its product line currently includes two applications.

stories.title: Future Secure AI raises $80 million
stories.summary: Sydney-founded Future Secure AI has raised $80 million in a round led by Square Peg and Yarra Capital Management. The company builds AI co-workers for large organizations and is now headquartered in Austin, Texas. The raise values the three-year-old startup at $1.2 billion.

stories.title: Discovered Materials launches $1 million challenge
stories.summary: San Francisco startup Discovered Materials has announced a $1 million challenge for AI models to solve five problems in materials science. The company, which uses AI to find substances for advanced chips, says frontier models have yet to master the complex physics required for new material development.

stories.title: Mindmax raises £2.5 million for AI learning
stories.summary: London-based Mindmax has raised £2.5 million in a round backed by Concept Ventures and the CEO of Helsing. The startup aims to help users develop their own cognitive abilities rather than outsourcing them to AI. The founder previously launched the language learning platform Memrise.

stories.title: Tutor Intelligence raises $75 million for robotics data
stories.summary: Tutor Intelligence has raised $75 million in a Series B round, bringing its total capital to $117 million. The MIT CSAIL spinout builds robots, foundation models, and deployments to collect data from real-world facilities. The company says robots need real work to learn how to move things.

stories.title: Lingchuan Technology raises $150 million for AI chips
stories.summary: Lingchuan Technology has raised roughly $150 million in a Series B round led by Yizhuang State Investment. The Kuaishou-affiliated startup designs chips for video-focused AI workloads. Its SL200 chip is already deployed across several internet companies, covering nearly all of Kuaishou's live-streaming business operations.

stories.title: Fal valuation doubles to $16 billion
stories.summary: Fal has raised $1.3 billion in a funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, doubling its valuation to $16 billion. The startup hosts and runs AI video, image, and audio models. The funding follows soaring demand for inference services, the process of running models that are already trained.

stories.title: Creandum closes $750 million fund
stories.summary: Creandum has closed its eighth fund with $750 million in capital. The firm intends to use the money to back early-stage technology companies. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Thailand revamps village funds
stories.summary: Thailand is restructuring its Village and Urban Community Funds to address bureaucratic inertia and opaque management. Director Charnkit Triratananont aims to transform the initiative into a community venture capital engine. The program has historically served as a lifeline for rural liquidity.

stories.title: Everstone AMC raises $179 million for private equity
stories.summary: Everstone AMC has raised $179.3 million in the first close of its private equity fund. The firm plans to invest in mid-market Indian companies, focusing on deals where it can secure control. The fund secured commitments from domestic investors, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals.

stories.title: Productivity Commission suggests venture capital tax changes
stories.summary: The Productivity Commission has recommended more flexible tax rules for venture capital to help startups secure funding. An interim report warned that current settings may cause viable businesses to miss out. It proposed allowing funds to invest outside existing eligibility criteria to broaden the pool of investors.

stories.title: EU venture capital framework update expected in 2027
stories.summary: The European Commission plans to propose a legislative update to its venture and growth capital markets by summer 2027. The initiative, part of the Savings and Investments Union Plan, will review existing fund regulations and private investment exit rules. Asset managers should prepare for new package proposals.

stories.title: Everstone Capital Partners India Fund closes at $200 million
stories.summary: Everstone AMC has secured approximately $200 million in the first close of its Everstone Capital Partners India Fund. The fund, which reached this milestone within three months of launch, targets mid-market Indian companies. It will focus on control-oriented growth investments through a Category II Alternative Investment Fund structure.

stories.title: Gaja Capital reports fundraising capacity
stories.summary: Gaja Capital reports it has the capacity to raise Rs 8,000 crore based on its current balance sheet and an 8.4 percent sponsor-commitment rate. The firm plans to launch two new funds in the 2026 to 2027 period, targeting a combined Rs 4,000 crore.

stories.title: Sequoia Capital restructures and closes London office
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital is closing its London office and ending its Arc and Scouts programs as part of a global restructuring. The firm raised $10 billion in new funds and will merge its early- and growth-stage teams. The firm says it is refocusing on high-conviction, selective investing.

stories.title: Sequoia Capital raises $10 billion in restructuring
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital has raised $10 billion in new funds while streamlining its global operations. The firm is flattening its partnership structure and discontinuing its accelerator and scout programs. It says the changes will allow it to concentrate resources on fewer companies and provide better support to founders.

stories.title: Sequoia Capital consolidates global operations
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital has raised $10 billion and is closing its London office to refocus on high-conviction investing. The firm is ending its Arc and Scouts programs and flattening its partnership structure. The overhaul marks a strategic shift away from the global expansion it pursued for two decades.

stories.title: Sequoia Capital retreats to Bay Area
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital is closing its international offices and programs to consolidate into a smaller, Bay Area-focused operation. The firm announced $10 billion in new funds alongside the move. The strategy signals a fundamental rethinking of how the firm operates after two decades of global expansion.

stories.title: Sequoia Capital ends expansion phase
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital has raised $10 billion and is closing its London office, ending its accelerator and scout programs, and merging its investment teams. The firm says it is rewinding to an earlier time when the team was smaller and focused more narrowly on Silicon Valley.

stories.title: Sequoia Capital exits London
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital is shutting its London office six years after opening it. The firm claims it can support European founders from the Bay Area and does not see the need for a local presence. Several staff members will be leaving the firm as a result.

stories.title: Scripbox moves toward IPO
stories.summary: Wealth management platform Scripbox has received shareholder approval to convert into a public limited company. The Accel-backed startup plans to list its shares through a fresh issue or an offer for sale. The timing remains subject to consultation with investment bankers.

stories.title: Wonder files for IPO
stories.summary: Food delivery startup Wonder has confidentially filed for an initial public offering. The company, founded by Marc Lore, has evolved from a delivery concept into a food technology business operating food hall-style locations. It has not yet disclosed the expected share price or volume.

stories.title: Go Digit profit falls 31 percent
stories.summary: Insurtech Go Digit reported a 31.1 percent year-on-year decline in net profit to 142.4 crore rupees for the September quarter. Despite a 1.7 percent rise in insurance revenue, the company faced a 62.4 percent sequential profit drop. Motor insurance remains the firm's largest business segment.

stories.title: Flood losses weigh on Go Digit results
stories.summary: Go Digit recorded a 31 percent year-on-year dip in net profit to 142 crore rupees for the July to September quarter. The company cited higher claims costs and flood-related losses as primary factors. Management noted that third-party motor insurance rates have not increased in five years.

stories.title: RateGain profit rises 47 percent
stories.summary: Travel SaaS firm RateGain reported a 46.5 percent increase in consolidated net profit to 74.7 crore rupees for the September quarter. Operating revenue jumped 152.6 percent following the acquisition of Sojern. Total expenses rose 158 percent year-on-year, while sequential net profit declined 21.3 percent.

stories.title: Amagi profit surges 30-fold
stories.summary: Cloud-native SaaS platform Amagi Media Labs reported a 2,860 percent year-on-year surge in net profit to 75 crore rupees for the second quarter. Revenue grew 27 percent to 476 crore rupees. The company attributed the results to operating leverage and cost efficiencies.

stories.title: Amagi reports sharp profit increase
stories.summary: Amagi registered a net profit of 74.83 crore rupees for the second quarter, compared to 2.52 crore rupees in the same period last year. The SaaS company also launched four AI products during the quarter. It plans to focus on improving cash conversion and operating leverage.

stories.title: Moneyview profit jumps 417 percent
stories.summary: Fintech company Moneyview reported a 417.6 percent year-on-year jump in consolidated net profit to 200.7 crore rupees for the September quarter. Operating revenue rose 41 percent to 1,120.2 crore rupees. Expenses grew 24.5 percent, a slower pace than the company's revenue growth.

stories.title: Tonbo Imaging turns profitable
stories.summary: Defence tech company Tonbo Imaging reported a net profit of 23.5 crore rupees for the September quarter, moving from a 9.6 crore rupee loss a year ago. Operating revenue surged 1,963.3 percent to 183.3 crore rupees. The company develops thermal imaging and sensor systems.

stories.title: Lenskart shares reach all-time high
stories.summary: Lenskart shares rose 11.1 percent to an all-time high of 767.4 rupees following its second-quarter results. The company reported a 124.7 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 232.5 crore rupees. Operating revenue grew 35.7 percent to 2,845 crore rupees during the period.

stories.title: Razorpay receives IPO approval
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Razorpay has received approval from SEBI for an initial public offering of 6,500 crore rupees. The company is reportedly targeting a valuation of 5 billion dollars.

stories.title: Nykaa profit triples in second quarter
stories.summary: Nykaa parent FSN E-Commerce Ventures reported a net profit of 101 crore rupees for the quarter ending September 30, up from 33 crore rupees a year earlier. Operating revenue grew 28 percent to 3,006 crore rupees. Expenses increased 25 percent during the same period.

stories.title: Canva CEO praised for layoff approach
stories.summary: Canva CEO Melanie Perkins is drawing attention for the company's approach to recent layoffs. The package offered to departing employees includes six months of salary and career support. The strategy has received praise on social media platforms including LinkedIn and X.

stories.title: The chief of staff role evolves
stories.summary: The chief of staff role is increasingly common in the startup ecosystem as a path to executive leadership. While the position is often seen as a modern remodel of middle management, legacy companies have employed similar roles for decades. It is typically a short-lived position.

stories.title: Operational foundations define startup growth
stories.summary: Startups often prioritize funding and sales while overlooking the operational foundations required to sustain growth. The article suggests that strong processes, reliable data, and governance are essential to building scalable businesses. A successful quarter does not necessarily indicate a well-built company.

stories.title: Sankalp aims to bridge founder gap
stories.summary: Sankalp is working to help entrepreneurs transition from developing concepts to market-ready businesses. The initiative focuses on the growing wave of innovation in climate action and sustainability. Founders require more than passion to turn early-stage ideas into scalable enterprises.

stories.title: Fintechs alerted to AI cyber threats
stories.summary: The government has issued an advisory warning financial institutions to treat AI-assisted cyberattacks as an immediate and continuing threat. Meanwhile, funding for India's B2C ecommerce sector fell 33 percent to 1.6 billion dollars between January and November 3, 2026, according to Tracxn data.

stories.title: Canva faces growth forecast cuts
stories.summary: Canva has been forced to slash its growth forecast as the company navigates the impact of AI on software businesses. The startup, which became the highest-valued female-founded company in the world, is currently rethinking its operations. The cost of providing AI tools has impacted the business.

stories.title: PM Modi meets space startups
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Prime Minister Modi interacted with founders of space startups and called for the wider adoption of space technology in various sectors. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Aina unveils AI-powered ring
stories.summary: Bengaluru startup Aina has unveiled an AI ring designed to anticipate user actions and control connected devices. Founded by former Ultrahuman executive Apoorv Shankar, the company spent 15 months in stealth. The ring features a screen and a proprietary operating system, with pre-orders starting at 399 dollars.

stories.title: Brightmind Partners targets a second $250 million cybersecurity fund
stories.summary: Brightmind Partners co-founder Stephen Ward says investors should sell on the way up rather than waiting for an IPO. The firm is now raising a second $250 million fund following its debut last year. Ward brings a background in the Coast Guard and the Secret Service to the firm.

stories.title: Harbinger raises $240 million to expand into defense
stories.summary: Electric truck startup Harbinger has raised $240 million in a Series D round to expand into battery storage and defense. The company has raised over $650 million to date. FedEx participated in the round, which comes one year after the company announced its Series C funding.

stories.title: Deepinder Goyal defends Temple wearable against credibility concerns
stories.summary: Deepinder Goyal defended the Temple brain-monitoring wearable following questions from doctors about its scientific validity. Goyal stated the company spent $30 million on development, including $20 million of his own money. He argued that a scam that pays nothing is not a scam anyone would run.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Evolution has shaped intelligence for billions of years. Artificial intelligence (AI) now raises a striking possibility: intelligence may begin to direct its own evolution. As AI agents become capable of modifying and evaluating their own behavior. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Align Before Aggregation: Basis-Consistent Federated LoRA under Heterogeneous Ranks
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) under heterogeneous client capacities is increasingly important, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with heterogeneous ranks makes it practical. Existing server-side aggregators compose local matrix updates $\Delta W_i$ from client-specific LoRA. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: CST-Bench: Benchmarking Counterfactual Spatial Transition Reasoning with Causal Transition On-Policy Self-Distillation
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing benchmarks mainly focus on static scene understanding. When objects are moved or swapped, models must infer not only spatial relations but also. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. Yet most evaluation is one-off: a benchmark run, a look at traces, a single score. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Epigraph-Form Guided Exploration
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Discovering cooperative behavior in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is challenging due to the combinatorial complexity of joint state-action spaces, which hinders the emergence of coordinated behaviors from trial-and-error alone. Intrinsic rewards are often used to aid. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: DelegateEval: Evaluating Platforms for Personal External Service Agents
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents that work for an individual over time may also help that individual serve external clients. We define a personal external service agent as an agent authorized and continuously managed by a specific individual to. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
